  - **S2 seam:** the tests wrap `gov.retrieval.lexical.search` with monkeypatch, so the link switches to store-b the first time it returns.
  - **S4 byte rule:** lines come from `git cat-file blob <commit>:<path>`. A line ends after its LF, so a CRLF line keeps both bytes. The last line is taken as it is, with no newline added. Lines count from 1 and both ends are inclusive. A cut item is hashed on its full lines.
- **discoveries:**
  - (1) Today the text form prints the result as JSON (`gov.cli.main._emit`), and `src/gov/cli/main.py` is not in the ticket's `allowed_paths`. The command would have to print the `store:` line itself; the test only checks stdout's first line.
  - (2) I read "the commit the store was built at" as the store's fingerprints `head`. One S1 case moves the folder's HEAD after the build and expects the build commit.
  - (3) For S3, either commit may appear as its full id or its first 12 hex digits, in `message` or `details`. A token from before this change, with no commit in it, is not planted, because the ticket doesn't say what it should get.
  - (4) Out of scope, found in the code and not tested: the chunker numbers lines with `str.splitlines`, which also splits on form feed, `\x1c`–`\x1e`, `\x85`, U+2028 and U+2029. The item reads lines with `bytes.splitlines`, which splits only on `\n`, `\r` and `\r\n`. In a file holding one of those characters, an item's line numbers can drift from its chunk.
  - (5) `gov accept`'s child drops every `PYTHON*` variable, `PYTHONUSERBASE` included, so with an empty HOME it crashed (it could not import pytest). Workaround for the accept run only: a HOME holding nothing but a `.local` link to `/home/usain/.local`. It was not a guard refusal.
- **risks:** S3's link case and S2 both depend on the link being switched by renaming a new link over it. The S2 seam assumes `retrieve` still calls the lexical facet as `lexical.search`. If a refactor stops doing that, the test fails with "the seam was not reached" rather than passing silently.
- **lessons:** The planted path map must pass `load_config` (`namespaces` is required) when tests go through `gov.cli.main`; the earlier tests that called `retrieve` directly never hit this. A continuation page can hold only repeats of a parent the first page already sent (W2-32 S7), so a guard must not ask the second page for evidence.
- **proposed_decisions:** none.
- **unresolved:** none blocking. Discoveries (1) and (2) are interpretations the CTO may want confirmed.
- **recommended_next_action:** The CTO writes the TESTS-READY marker and merges `999b12111` into the engineer's branch. The engineer builds S1–S5 and runs `gov accept W2-138`; if their HOME is emptied, it needs the `.local` link from discovery (5).
